name: Raspberry Pi Camera (Motion Detection)
description: In my free time, I enjoy building projects with my Raspberry Pi 4. In this project, I connected a camera and a motion sensor to the Raspberry Pi. When movement is detected, the camera takes a photo and sends it to me via Telegram using a bot. I also added a VPN connection to access the Raspberry Pi remotely with OpenVPN.
